title: Mosaic Receipt
tagline: Extension that generates Mosaic image based on the nature and type of transactions
description: Extension that generates receipts with an cool Mosaic image based on the nature and type of transactions performed on the given Wallet. Just something cool to make expense reporting and reviewing transaction history fun. Is for easier data analysis and expense reporting. This dapp uses Blockscout and 1inch.
how_its_made: Made using AI to generate a Mosaic style iage related to the group of transacations or cross chain swaps. Instead of looking at boring paper receipts to do expense reporting and analytics look at the images in receipts to see the categories of things being purchased. Smart contract deployed to Blockscout and extension for cross chain swap info created for 1inch.
